metric: time-to-jam: fraction of units ending in a decoder fixed point (tools/future/tts_gate.stuck_run), and median jam onset over expected duration at 159 wpm

three_classes.healthy: median duration/expected 0.87-0.95, no jam. bf16, q8, q4, loo-down2, loo-emb2, awq-b3g64, awq-b3g64-e2
three_classes.jam: envelope locks to constant rms and the unit runs to max_new_tokens. sens_a/b/c, b3plain, b3g64, awq-b3g128, awq-b3g128-e2, mx-b2-d3/d4/d4o4, loo-qkv2, loo-o2, loo-gu2, b2awq
three_classes.run_to_cap_noise: duration/expected exactly 2.31 (the cap) with varying envelope, so NOT a fixed point. b2g32 rms 0.019, b2g128 rms 0.006, b2g64 and b2plain rms 0.070. The original gate set scores these the same way it scores a jam.

the_jam_is_not_a_model_property: bf16 jams 0/8. So do q8 and q4. Every jamming arm comes from the awq_fold.py allocation path; stock mlx quantization at 8 and 4 bits never produces it.

non_composition.claim: At bits=3 group=64 AWQ, embed_tokens:2 alone is healthy and down_proj:2 alone is healthy against a 4-bit base, but the two together jam.
non_composition.MISSING_CONTROL: awq-b3g64 + down_proj:2 alone. Without it the result is confounded: the jam may be the COMPOSITION of the two organ tilts, or it may be that down_proj:2 simply does not survive a 3-bit base at all, independent of embed_tokens. This is the same confound the one-off already hit (2-bit down_proj survives a q4 base and breaks against q3).
non_composition.status: REFUTED by the deciding arm; see attribution below

group_size: awq-b3g64 is healthy 0/8 while awq-b3g128 jams 6/8. At 3 bits, group 64 vs 128 is the difference between a working model and a jamming one, with the allocation held identical.
caveat: n=8 units per arm, one seed. Class membership is robust (a jam is a 14-30 s flat run, not a marginal number); the orderings within a class are not.

attribution.arm_built: sens-d = awq_fold bits=3 group=64 alloc down_proj:2 ONLY
attribution.result: 3/8 jam (median onset/expected 0.77) plus 2/8 with a 31.8-32.0 s silence dropout and spoken 0.29/0.37 -- 5/8 broken
attribution.verdict: Composition explains nothing. down_proj:2 alone against the 3-bit base is already broken; adding embed_tokens:2 (sens-a, 5/8 jam) does not make it meaningfully worse, and embed_tokens:2 alone against the same base is clean 0/8. The tilt that breaks the model is down_proj:2, and it breaks only because the BASE dropped from 4 bits to 3 -- loo-down2 applies the identical tilt to a 4-bit base and jams 0/8.
attribution.confirms: LAW023 -- a sensitivity map is a function of (organ, base representation, corpus). This is the base-representation axis, reproduced in a second modality (audio TTS) on a different architecture family, with the single-organ control present on both bases.
attribution.correction: The previous commit framed this as two safe organs being unsafe together. That was wrong: the control that would have distinguished the two readings had not been built yet, which the receipt did record as NOT ATTRIBUTED. It is now attributed against composition.
attribution.third_failure_class: sens-d introduces a failure none of a/b/c showed: 31.8-32.0 s of near-silence at rms 0.019-0.027. That one the dropout gate DOES catch -- so the gate set is not uniformly blind, it is blind specifically to the non-silent fixed point.
